# COCO source-parity images

These three unchanged COCO val2017 photographs are small, reproducible numerical
test inputs, not an accuracy dataset or calibration sample. Attribution and byte
identities are in `attribution.json`. All three originals are licensed under
[CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/), verified against both
COCO's image-license records and the linked original Flickr photo pages.

- **Mt. Washington**, Moosealope — https://www.flickr.com/photos/8510057@N02/4377710907/
- **Stoplight on AZ-90, Sierra Vista on the horizon**, vaxomatic — https://www.flickr.com/photos/vax-o-matic/4466652187/
- **DSC_9931**, ChefMattRock — https://www.flickr.com/photos/chefmattrock/3397730036/

No changes were made to the JPEG files. Resizing/normalization in tests does not
modify the stored originals.
